ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards
